## Eggplant - Miso Glazed Baked Eggplant 

| Servings | Time | Source |
|:---|:---|:-------------------|
| 2  | 20-30 min | Conscious Plant Kitchen, [theconsciousplantkitchen.com/miso-glazed-eggplant](https://www.theconsciousplantkitchen.com/miso-glazed-eggplant/) | 


### Ingredients:

- 2-3 eggplants (preferably Japanese eggplant) 
- glaze 
  - 2 TB miso (30 g)
  - 2 tsp sesame oil (10 g) 
  - 2 tsp maple syrup (10 g) 
  - 1.5 tsp soy sauce/tamari (6g)
  - 1 tsp rice vinegar (4g) 
  - 1 tsp mirin (4 g) 
- for cooking: sesame oil & sesame seeds 
- for serving: green onions

### Directions 

- half eggplants and score diagonal lines on inside to get diamond shapes 
- saute eggplants in oil for 2-3 minutes (inside/score face down) on medium/high 
- flip eggplants & cover for 3-4 minutes and reduce to low/medium; set oven on broil high 
- put eggplants on baking sheet and glaze (inside/score face up); top with sesame seeds
- broil in oven for 4-5 minutes until glaze is bubbly 
- top with green onions and serve
